_comment: Judge config for OpenRouter inference. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var or pass --api-key on the CLI — do NOT commit the key here. Use any OpenRouter model id for judge_model (see openrouter.ai/models). Provider is auto-detected from api_base (non-localhost = openai_compatible), which selects response_format={type:json_object} instead of the Ollama format=json field.
